top_signals.title: US Retail Gasoline Hits Four-Year High; Yen Gains | Bloomberg Brief 09/03/2026
top_signals.summary: US equity futures waver and a global bond rout eases as higher yields attract investors. The yen strengthens as traders weigh intervention risks, while the BOJ is said to favor raising rates by a quarter point this month. President Trump says the latest strikes on Iran. US diesel prices hit a four-year high. Broadcom slips after the chipmaker’s results and short-term forecast failed to meet lofty expectations, despite predicting a boom in AI chips over the next two years. Seema Shah of Principal Asset Management joins "Bloomberg Brief" to discuss the implications of elevated yields on stocks. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

U.S. International Trade in Goods and Services, July 2026
top_signals.summary: The U.S. goods and services trade deficit increased in July 2026 according to the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis and the U.S. Census Bureau. The deficit increased from $71.2 billion in June (revised) to $88.6 billion in July, as imports increased and exports decreased. The goods deficit increased $17.6 billion in July to $119.6 billion. The services surplus increased $0.2 billion in July to $31.0 billion.
